column1: # Questions that ask two things, and — just as important — the ones that must NOT be split.
# The hard part is never finding "and". It joins two clauses in "the density of gold and how does
# it compare to lead", but it joins two elements in "compare gold and silver", two bounds in
# "between 1000 and 2000 kelvin", and two aspects in "reactivity, density and applications".
# Splitting any of those breaks a question that already works.
# COMPOUND = must split and be answered. NOSPLIT = must stay whole.
